correctness.rationale: Riemann–Hurwitz yields genus five; Klein-four idempotents give an isogeny of degree a power of two and preserve p-torsion for odd p. In p≡7 mod8 the elliptic quotient factors have zero Hasse invariant. Exact symbolic coefficient extraction and two independent polynomial calculations yield the monic gcds \(a+1\), \(a+1\), and \( (a+1)(a^2-3a+1)\). These identities prove the algebraic-closure parameter classification, without relying on a finite scan. Exact exhaustive F31² arithmetic for all 29 rational parameters proves maximality iff a∈{14,20,30} and quotient point count identity. All possible branch-set projectivities are enumerated exactly to distinguish the genus-three quotients. Both finite limits and unproved wider scope are explicit.
